atoms.text: To represent the vibrations that make sound, scientists use sound wave diagrams. Tall waves represent loud sounds. Short waves represent quiet sounds.

atoms.a: Do you think the wave in this image is representing a loud or quiet sound?

instruction.text: Sort each sound into high or low volume based on its waves.

trainers.hint:
The waves of high volume sounds are tall.
The waves of low-pitched sounds are shorter.

feedback.finish: The taller the waves, the higher the volume of the sound.
